'''Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn''' is a ship Engineer based at '''Trophy Camp''' in the '''Wolf 397''' system. A former CQC competitor and established bounty hunter, he specialises in projectile weapons and is one of the independent entry points into ship [[Engineering]].<ref name="edwiki-tod">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Tod_%22The_Blaster%22_McQuinn Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn], Elite Dangerous Wiki. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Tod provides '''Grade 5''' engineering for [[Multi-Cannon|Multi-Cannons]] and Rail Guns. His [[Fragment Cannon]] services reach Grade 3, while [[Cannon]] services reach Grade 2.<ref name="inara-tod">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/6/ Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Location ==

* '''System:''' Wolf 397
* '''Body:''' Trus Madi
* '''Facility:''' Trophy Camp
* '''Engineer scope:''' Ship weapons
* '''Referral required:''' None
* '''System permit required:''' No

== Access requirements ==

Tod McQuinn's whereabouts are common knowledge, so no referral from another Engineer is required. Access has two further conditions:<ref name="inara-tod" />

# Earn '''more than 15 bounty vouchers'''.
# Provide '''100,000 credits worth of bounty vouchers''' at Trophy Camp.

The meeting condition counts vouchers earned, while the final contribution uses their combined credit value. Redeeming the vouchers needed for the contribution elsewhere removes them from the value available to hand in at the workshop.

For suitable targets, voucher handling, and the complete ordered process, see [[Unlocking Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]].

== Workshop reputation ==

Reputation with Tod McQuinn increases by:<ref name="inara-tod" />

* crafting modifications at his workshop; or
* handing in Alliance bounty vouchers at Trophy Camp.

Higher reputation opens the grades that Tod supports. INARA notes that station services may not appear immediately after the first unlock; beginning a new game session can make those services available.<ref name="inara-tod" />

The available modification families, effects, trade-offs, and recipes belong to [[Engineering Blueprints]]. Compatible secondary modifications belong to [[Experimental Effects]].

=== Operations-era services ===

Current Live records add four Operations-era services to Tod's workshop:<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 30 June 2026. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-tod" />

* '''Force Impact''' for Cannons through Grade 2
* '''Double Screaming''' for Fragment Cannons through Grade 3
* '''Rapid Phase''' for Multi-Cannons through Grade 5
* '''Enduring Feedback''' for Rail Guns through Grade 5

These services are not part of Legacy Engineering. Their exact modifiers, costs, and module compatibility belong to the corresponding [[Engineering Blueprints|Blueprint]] records. Current INARA data identifies Force Impact as available through Tod but does not yet publish its finished parameter values.

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Tod McQuinn blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade he offers, and Experimental Effects still require an appropriate workshop visit.

== Direct referrals ==

Tod McQuinn directly introduces two Engineers after the Commander reaches Grade 3 access and progresses approximately one-third of the way toward Grade 4 with him:

* '''[[Selene Jean]]'''<ref name="inara-selene">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/8/ Selene Jean — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>
* '''[[Petra Olmanova]]''' in the Colonia region<ref name="inara-petra">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/24/ Petra Olmanova — Engineer], INARA. Accessed 11 September 2026.</ref>

Each referral reveals an Engineer; it does not satisfy that Engineer's own meeting or unlock requirements. Their locations, requirements, services, and later referrals belong to their individual articles. For the complete network, see [[Engineer Unlock Guide]].
